turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. Was Owen heard before you entered that zero?
Then get to it. Was he heard first?
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.
That's a threat, not evidence. I printed your procedure, and there's no committee in it. What do you have on the essay itself?
No. Yours. Show me something or take the zero off.
